image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a heavy agricultural plow attached to the rear of a tractor. The image features two large, curved metal moldboards (shares) in the foreground, showing signs of wear and soil residue. To the right, a large, treaded tractor tire is visible. The background shows a blurred field with dry grass or stubble. The lighting suggests late afternoon or early morning with strong highlights on the metal surfaces.
